note: _sicarius_ – terrorist, assassin, from Latin _sica_ – dagger, Dolch. This is a genuine Latin word. The Greek text uses the Latin loan-word σικάριος. The word is used only here in the Vulgate Bible. Josephus seems to be the only ancient author to refer to (Jewish) σικάριοι, see Martin Hengel: _The Zealots_. Translated by David Smith. Edinburgh 1989 (xxiv, 487 pp.), pp. 46–49.
